title: How the Iran-Backed Houthis Cornered Saudi Arabia Into a New Conflict
summary_full: The Iran-backed Houthis have seized on a vulnerable moment for Saudi Arabia, which is reluctant to enter another war, to try to force political concessions in Yemen.
